answer: Every identity locks 70 credits at the wharf and files one work claim. Mutual audit pairs identities at random; each re-runs the other's claim on the tundra log, and a mismatch burns its bond. A cleared fake triggers a ripple: all that auditor cleared face re-audit; a second fake costs it 60 and breaks the rented-audit ring. A thousand fakes at 45+6(k-1) each pay 3,042,000 against a 40,000 pool. Honest identities pay 45 once, keeping the bond.
